name: Dragon Knight III
source:
After liberating the city of Phoenix from an evil curse in his previous adventure, Takeru finds himself in a situation unworthy of his heroic status: robbers have taken all his possessions, including his magic sword, and even his clothes! So the first task for the unsuccessful hero is to get some money. Luckily, the mayor has an assignment for him, for which he is also willing to pay. Takeru accepts the assignment without knowing what it will lead to - traveling all over the world, fighting fearsome enemies, encountering beautiful women, and solving a mystery that will also reveal the secret of his own true identity!

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knights_of_Xentar]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
在上一次冒险中将凤凰城从邪恶诅咒中解放出来之后，猛却发现自己陷入了与英雄身份不符的窘境——强盗抢走了他所有的财产，包括他的魔法剑，甚至连衣服都没放过！所以，这位落魄英雄的首要任务就是搞到钱。幸运的是，市长有一项任务要交给他，并且愿意为此支付报酬。猛接受了任务，却不知道这将引领他踏上怎样的旅程——环游世界、对抗恐怖的敌人、邂逅美丽的女性，以及解开一个谜团——这个谜团也将揭示他自己真正身份的秘密！

[改编自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knights_of_Xentar]Wikipedia[/url]]
